result.summary: Several visual bugs: a broken delivery-fee value (€NaN), a clipped restaurant name, and a category chip cut off at the edge.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid fee.
issues.suggestion: Handle missing or invalid delivery-fee data and display a fallback such as a real price or 'Free' instead of NaN.

issues.description: The last restaurant name in Fastest near you is truncated ('Trattoria Piccol').
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, a second line, or ellipsis with enough space so the full name remains readable.

issues.description: The last category chip is cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add peek/overflow padding or fade so users can see there are more categories to scroll.
